Listen to this...! The manga I posted on 
Umatter yesterday got a lot of positive 
feedback...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I even received super long Umamallows...! 
Man, I just can't stop vanity searching...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hearing what people think make me 
reeeeeeally happy, you know!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fuhehe...♪ Whoops. I gotta hurry, homeroom 
is gonna...!

It seems Kiseki stayed up late reading 
reviews of her manga. She looks happy, but 
it seems she didn't get enough rest...
